decisions.issues: Acceptable, with only minor deviations. Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin with at most light stubble, small gold ear stud, long curly black hair, rope burns on his chest, tunic off, cream dhoti on, bandage on one forearm. The script beat is there. The Woman is wringing the cloth into a clay basin with her mouth open, speaking sharply. The Fisherman is in a red lungi with the white shoulder cloth on his own left shoulder, relaying her words with a half smile and a gesture. The setting is the same dim mud-walled, thatched interior with a hearth as 5.5. There is no text or pseudo-text in the art, and I checked the hands and feet at zoom: they are sound. The upper half (plain mud wall and thatch) gives plenty of clear space for both Fisherman balloons. Minor points: (1) the Woman seems to wear a sleeveless under-bodice beneath her draped cloth, which could read as a fitted blouse, against her 5.4 description; (2) Nagoji sits at mid-right, about level with the Woman, rather than clearly in the foreground; (3) the Woman looks toward the men instead of 'at no one in particular'. None of these is disqualifying. v08 was the only candidate offered.
